name: Momentum Breakout
about: Buys the NIFTY 500 stocks with the strongest 6- and 12-month momentum on the day they close at a new 52-week high on heavy volume. Exits only at a fixed 14% stop-loss or a 1:2 target (+28%), held at the broker as one two-leg GTT.
source: Strategy #1 of the AI Trader series (Part 1). Parameters picked from a 2016-2026 parameter study: the middle of a stable area (13-16% stop with a 1:2 target).
style: trend following, swing to positional (weeks to months)
buy_rules: uptrend: price above the 50-day average, which is above the 200-day average
closes at a new 52-week high (above the highest high of the previous 252 sessions)
no more than {max_ext_pct}% above the 20-day EMA

risk_suggested.basis: These are the settings the AI Trader's original live bot uses. Risk per trade and the number of positions are sized so that most of the capital is usually invested; smaller sizes leave much of it idle. The market filter keeps the strategy from buying while the NIFTY 500 is in a downtrend. The weekly loss limit and the drawdown halt are set to act only in unusually bad periods for this strategy.
